braco.texto: Participants received troriluzole 200 milligrams (mg) (100 mg\*2) capsules orally once daily for the first two weeks and up-titrated to 280 mg (140 mg\*2) capsules orally once daily for the next eight weeks, in the double-blind randomization phase.
